searches.answer: The trending tech topics for 2026 include the expanding use of AI, which is no longer exclusive to data scientists and is now accessible to traditional knowledge workers for creating content through simple prompts. The Internet of Things (IoT) is also transforming due to miniaturization, cost-effectiveness, and the availability of shared radio spectrum, enhanced by 5G technology. Virtual Reality (VR) is proving powerful and cost-effective in teaching soft skills and enabling safe, realistic environments for practicing complex tasks. Additionally, low-code development is becoming a standard part of digital transformation, allowing non-technical teams to build simple apps while engineers focus on complex work. Quantum computing and post-quantum cryptography are gaining attention, and 5G is expected to power IoT devices, autonomous vehicles, and immersive experiences.
